containers.gone.in: card_create's in is not used. A card inside a container (goal, flow) is made with the container's path and its name as target (e.g. Goals:Launch.Design). To move a card made to another container, use in in card_update's value
containers.gone.items: items is not used. What a goal holds are cards inside it: create them inside with card_create and <goal path>.<name> as target (e.g. Goals:Launch.Design). Move one to another goal with in in card_update's value (a goal's path; in: null takes it out of the goal), and order them with position in value. Read them with card_read's cards and with in in card_list's value
containers.gone.nodes: nodes is not used. A flow's nodes are cards inside the flow: card_create with <flow path>.<node name> as target (e.g. Behavior:Checkout.review) and {"kind": "process", "steps": [{"do": "read"}], "connections": [{"line": "reads", "from": "steps[0]", "to": "Data:Order"}, {"line": "next", "to": "<next node name>"}]} as value. To make a flow and its nodes together, leave out target and give value by path in one call (the flow and its nodes together). Between nodes the lines are next, branch (field when), else, onError and onTimeout; where a process row reads and writes, the lines reads and writes (from steps[0] and so on); a flow run, the line runs; a key, the line key (field use). card_read with the flow as target reads the paths of its nodes (cards), with a node as target that card. The shape is in guide with about: flow
containers.holds.ghost: A card ghost cannot be put inside a container (inside {container_path}). Put card ghosts in a section
containers.holds.notContainer: {container_path} is a {container_kind} and cannot hold cards (only containers can: {containers})
containers.holds.onlyInside: {kind} can only be put inside {holders}. Create it with target as <path of the {first}>.<name> (e.g. Behavior:Checkout.review)
containers.move.inShape: in is the path of a container (a string), or null to take the card out of it
containers.move.innerOnly: {path} is a {kind} and cannot be moved to another flow (create it inside the destination flow with card_create, and delete this node with card_delete)
containers.move.intoItself: {into_path} is {path} or inside it, so {path} cannot be put into it
containers.move.rewritten: Paths rewritten in the project to follow the move: {rewritten}
containers.nodeKey.gone: {key} is not used. Write it as a line in connections: {line}
containers.nodeKey.lineBranch: {"line": "branch", "to": "<destination node>", "fields": {"when": "<condition>"}} (in the order they are tried)
containers.nodeKey.lineEvent: {"line": "event", "to": "<path of the flow to wait for>", "fields": {"outcome": "success"}}
containers.nodeKey.lineNext: {"line": "next", "to": "<next node name>"} (two or more split into parallel paths)
containers.nodeKey.lineReadWrite: {"line": "{line}", "from": "{here}", "to": "<path of a card, field or row>"}
containers.nodeKey.lineReturnPeer: {"line": "peer", "to": "<path of the partner flow to return to>"}
containers.nodeKey.shapeNote: (the shape of a node is in guide with about: flow)
containers.release.clash: Taking {name} out of {container} would give it the same name as another card (rename or move one first)
